metadata.dataset_name: BMW Electrified Fleet Customer Voice & Technology Domain Benchmark
metadata.scope: 16 Matched BMW BEV & PHEV Models (i5 Sedan/Touring, i7, 5er PHEV, 7er PHEV; 100% ICE & F70 excluded)

Difficult to Use.definition: UX, cognitive friction or ergonomic hurdle

aspect.cn: 温控储物、座椅、空气与舒适
aspect.en: Thermal control, Storage, Smart seating, Air & Comfort

engineering_intelligence.root_cause_analysis: Transition to synthetic Veganza upholstery reduces breathability compared to Merino leather; elimination of mechanical sunblind on panoramic roof causes greenhouse heating.
engineering_intelligence.recommended_pipeline_action: Increase perforation density and active ventilation CFM on Veganza trims; upgrade low-emissivity glass coating on fixed panoramic roofs.
engineering_intelligence.key_praise_summary: Superb NVH acoustic isolation at 130-160 km/h; comfortable rear lounge seating on i7.
engineering_intelligence.key_pain_point_summary: Veganza thermal perspiration in summer; complex touch-slider air vents replacing physical dials.

engineering_intelligence.root_cause_analysis: Ultrasonic proximity sensors for i7 powered doors have ultra-conservative abort thresholds against curbs and parking pillars; mechanical clutching lacks effortless manual bypass.
engineering_intelligence.recommended_pipeline_action: Recalibrate ultrasonic threshold algorithms for close-proximity objects; introduce low-resistance electro-mechanical freewheeling in manual door override.
engineering_intelligence.key_praise_summary: Iconic front grill presence, solid body panel fit, and aerodynamic exterior profile.
engineering_intelligence.key_pain_point_summary: i7 automated door aborts in tight garages; rear trunk kick sensor fails on ~30% of attempts.

aspect.cn: 补能体验、续航管理、对外供电
aspect.en: Charging experience, Range management, V2X/Power supply

engineering_intelligence.root_cause_analysis: CLAR platform 400V battery thermal inertia without predictive pre-conditioning triggers severe cold-charging throttle (drops from 205 kW to 60 kW). Real-world winter range deviates up to 35% from WLTP.
engineering_intelligence.recommended_pipeline_action: Expose manual battery pre-conditioning toggle in OS QuickSelect bar; integrate dynamic low-temperature buffer into SoC routing algorithms.
engineering_intelligence.key_praise_summary: High DC peak charging speeds (>200 kW) during warm seasons; smooth regenerative coasting in adaptive mode.
engineering_intelligence.key_pain_point_summary: Winter range drop and charge flap freezing / delayed cable release.

engineering_intelligence.root_cause_analysis: BMW OS 8.5/9 removed physical HVAC controls and favourite buttons, shifting micro-climate controls 2-3 levels deep into touch menus, increasing driver cognitive load.
engineering_intelligence.recommended_pipeline_action: Implement persistent customized climate bar on display bottom; deploy on-edge Small Language Model (SLM) to reduce IPA voice assistant response latency below 800ms.
engineering_intelligence.key_praise_summary: Stunning Curved Display resolution; immersive Bowers & Wilkins 4D Diamond Surround Sound.
engineering_intelligence.key_pain_point_summary: Cluttered QuickSelect widgets obscuring map; lack of physical buttons for primary functions.

aspect.cn: 驾驶控制、底盘、乘员保护
aspect.en: Drive control, Chassis dynamics, Occupant protection

engineering_intelligence.root_cause_analysis: PHEV ICE start-up during kickdown experiences mild clutch jerk during torque handover; one-pedal adaptive recuperation decelerates unexpectedly approaching roundabouts.
engineering_intelligence.recommended_pipeline_action: Harmonize electric motor torque ramp-down during ICE ignition transition; provide haptic steering feedback when adaptive recuperation engages.
engineering_intelligence.key_praise_summary: Unrivalled 9.95/10 ride quality: benchmark chassis poise, agile steering feel, and zero roll.
engineering_intelligence.key_pain_point_summary: PHEV kickdown transition jerk; inconsistent deceleration in adaptive regen mode.

aspect.cn: 手机与车互联、远程服务、OTA
aspect.en: Smartphone integration, Remote telematics, OTA updates

engineering_intelligence.root_cause_analysis: Telematics Control Unit (TCU) enters deep sleep in underground concrete structures, causing My BMW App cloud command timeouts; 5G eSIM network handshakes fail on roaming.
engineering_intelligence.recommended_pipeline_action: Implement local BLE fall-back pairing for My BMW App remote climatization; streamline carrier profile eSIM auto-provisioning.
engineering_intelligence.key_praise_summary: Digital Key Plus Ultra-Wideband (UWB) hands-free phone unlocking; remote 3D view camera surround.
engineering_intelligence.key_pain_point_summary: My BMW App 'Vehicle Unreachable' timeouts in underground garages; CarPlay audio dropouts.

engineering_intelligence.root_cause_analysis: EU GSR2 regulatory speed limit audible chimes trigger immediately at +1 km/h; Parking Assistant Pro disengages when detecting angled curbs.
engineering_intelligence.recommended_pipeline_action: Create one-touch steering wheel shortcut to mute GSR2 alerts; enhance curb terrain edge-detection in ultrasonic parking model.
engineering_intelligence.key_praise_summary: Highway Assistant Level 2+ hands-free driving with eye-activation lane change is the best-in-class benchmark.
engineering_intelligence.key_pain_point_summary: Mandatory GSR2 speed warning bongs; parking app disengagement on gravel/sloped curbs.

aspect.cn: 用户手册、售后交车与综合服务
aspect.en: User manual, Dealership delivery & General service

engineering_intelligence.root_cause_analysis: Digital user manual navigation is unintuitive for complex EV features; delivery handovers at dealerships lack deep EV charging onboarding.
engineering_intelligence.recommended_pipeline_action: Embed interactive animated tutorials in the central display during first DC charge; standardize EV dealer delivery checklists.
engineering_intelligence.key_praise_summary: High dealer professionalism and premium service vehicle availability.
engineering_intelligence.key_pain_point_summary: Unanswered technical questions regarding wallbox installation and DC charging limits.
